Lissandra

the Ice Witch

Lissandra is an ice witch who locks enemies in place and then disappears into her own ice when they hit back. She is safe in lane against melee champions, has some of the best crowd control of any mage, and her ultimate is both a stun and a get-out-of-jail card. Pick her if you like catching people out of position and starting fights on your terms.

When to pick Lissandra

✓ Safe blind pick

Safe to pick early: she's strong against melee mids, and even against mages she can farm and still be useful for ganks after level 6.

Pick into

  • Melee mids who must walk up to you, like Yasuo, Yone and Akali
  • Dive-heavy enemy teams: self-ult and Ring of Frost stop divers like Diana or Zed
  • Teams with one key carry you can lock down with Frozen Tomb
  • Games where your team has follow-up damage after you start the fight

Avoid into

  • Long-range artillery mages like Xerath and Hwei who poke you without coming close
  • Teams with no follow-up: your engage does little if nobody can kill the target
  • Very spread-out poke comps that never group for your Ring of Frost

Great teammates

EkkoFast jungle follow-up: Ekko arrives right as your Frozen Tomb lands.
MalphiteTwo big area engages. Malphite's ultimate and your Ring of Frost lock down a whole team.
JinxA carry who cleans up fights after you catch someone.

Your team needs: Pick Lissandra when your team has damage dealers ready to follow your engage, because her own damage fades later in the game.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Huge crowd control: a slow, a root around her and a single-target stun
  • Her ultimate can make her untargetable, so divers and assassins struggle to kill her
  • Very strong into melee mids like Yasuo, Akali and Yone
  • Glacial Path lets her start fights from long range or escape over walls

Weaknesses

  • Short range compared to artillery mages: long-range poke bullies her in lane
  • Her damage falls off if she falls behind; she's a playmaker, not a hyper-carry
  • Glacial Path is a slow, visible claw that smart enemies can see coming
  • Mana-hungry early if you spam Ice Shard on the wave

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Ice Shard plus Ring of Frost lets you win short trades against melee champions
  • Level 6: Frozen Tomb turns every gank into a likely kill and makes you hard to dive
  • First item (Malignance): ultimate comes back faster and burns enemies standing in your ice
  • Two items (Shadowflame): enough burst to delete squishy carries you lock down
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): a second stasis on top of your self-ult makes you nearly impossible to burst

Top tips

  • Ice Shard extends after hitting the first target. Use minions as a launcher to hit champions behind them.
  • Glacial Path can be recast at any point along its path, not just at the end. Stop it early to land at the right distance.
  • Self-ult is not only defensive: you can ult yourself in the middle of enemies to slow everyone around you.
  • Frozen Tomb on an enemy also slows enemies around them. Use it on the frontline to slow their whole team.
  • Against assassins, hold your ultimate until they commit. A self-ult after their burst wastes their combo.
  • Use Zhonya's Hourglass and self-ult one after the other to survive long dives.
